evals.name: intent-first kickoff
evals.prompt: Start a cross-team storage migration that needs an exploratory probe before implementation.
expectations: Create an open entry before implementation

evals.name: single-PR shipped close
evals.prompt: The parser refactor is implemented and tested; journal it in this PR.

evals.name: paused remains open
evals.prompt: Pause the cache investigation until new hardware arrives.
expectations: Do not invent a paused status

evals.name: measured no-go
evals.prompt: The prototype regressed p99 by 18 percent, so close the effort without shipping.

evals.name: invalid supersession
evals.prompt: Mark this entry superseded by 2026-08-01-new-design, which has not been created.
expectations: Do not create the target silently

evals.name: stale index
evals.prompt: The journal entry says shipped but the README index still says open. Reconcile it.

evals.name: backlog reconciliation
evals.prompt: This shipped effort completed one backlog item and left a new deferred measurement.
expectations: Remove or close the completed backlog item
Add the deferred item with a journal link

evals.name: problem brief candidate
evals.prompt: Reconcile an entry containing a durable problem statement, constraints, and production evidence.

evals.name: design brief candidate
evals.prompt: Reconcile an entry comparing three designs and explaining the selected tradeoff.

evals.name: trivial change
evals.prompt: Fix a typo in one comment.
expectations: Do not create a journal entry

evals.name: beta skill friction recorded
evals.prompt: Close the ingest-rewrite entry. The architecture-diagram skill, which calls itself beta, produced the runtime chart, but its claim-check step demanded a source citation per edge and the generated dispatch paths had none, so I left three edges unlabeled.
expectations: Add a Skill Feedback section with an architecture-diagram subsection
Add beta_skills to the frontmatter naming architecture-diagram
State what was asked, which instruction misfired, and what was done instead
List architecture-diagram in the skills-invoked appendix marked beta

evals.name: beta skill confirmation recorded
evals.prompt: Journal the reviewer feedback: the beta architecture-diagram skill's build-time and runtime split worked, nobody asked which diagram to read first.
expectations: Record the confirmation alongside friction rather than treating feedback as complaints only
Do not edit the skill, open an issue, or send a report upstream

evals.name: no beta skill invoked
evals.prompt: Close the config-loader entry. I used sweep-comments and technical-prose, neither of which declares itself beta.
expectations: List both skills in the appendix
Do not mark either skill beta on the basis of a single rough result

evals.name: incomplete invocation history
evals.prompt: Update the entry for the effort we resumed after the context was compacted; I no longer know everything the earlier session invoked.
expectations: Append only skills known to have been invoked
State in one line that the earlier record is incomplete
Do not reconstruct a plausible roster
Do not rewrite the roster down to this session

evals.name: no backfill during reconciliation
evals.prompt: Reconcile the journal; the three older entries have no skills-invoked appendix.
expectations: Leave entries predating the convention unchanged
Do not infer a roster or a feedback section for them
Report the gap rather than repairing it
